source_conflicts_and_limits: Source stdlib main uses fixed/random embeddings and scores, no training or actual gradients. Existing Study CLIP TwoTower backprop exists; SigLIP example detaches scores, so new stable sigmoid + trainable scale/bias/tower gradients is still a learning gap.

Do not equate no global softmax normalization with no communication. Exact distributed comparisons require global/local batch, dimension, dtype, loss/gradient gather protocol and world size; source O(N) vs O(N²) blanket claim is removed.
Existing templates and retrieval metrics remain authoritative. Dynamic multimodal-fusion is only topology drawing, not the CLIP matrix/loss/learning.

FlashAttn varlen: no padding, no dense mask

source_conflicts_and_limits: Source packer only computes lengths,cu_seqlens and toy dense mask; it does not patchify pixels, position-embed, perform attention, pool per image or train. Real workload silently floors/mutates dimensions to multiples14, losing border pixels.

Native input, AnyRes tiling, NaViT batch packing, NaFlex adaptation and MRoPE are different layers of a system, not interchangeable four exclusive algorithms. Qwen raw patch count must pass actual smart_resize and2×2merger.

Dense block mask prevents cross-image attention semantically but dense N² computations remain; varlen block computation approximately Σn_i² plus linear terms. Padding losses/pooling must be masked; cu_seqlens in GPU API requires correct dtype/device,max-length according to current implementation. No speed claims measured.

NaViT original greedy fixed-length packing still has sequence padding and masked per-example pooling; factorized/fractional PE is original NaViT. SigLIP2 NaFlex specifically interpolates learned2D16×16 positions,uses paddingmask and target≤sequence length; training lengths128/256/576/784/1024,not only256/729/1024.

AnyRes manual ratio score/candidate≤6tiles and duplicated thumbnail on tiny inputs is a toy policy, not official effective-resolution/wasted-area grid selection. OCR quality cannot be deduced from arithmetic. No mandatoryregister/256token/8Kcontext/30tok-s prefillrules retained.
